title: Add a health card to the counter page
visibleChange: A green 'Health check: ok' card appears below the counter.

acceptanceCriteria.description: index.html contains the health card element
app.js exposes health() returning status ok
acceptanceCriteria.code: const { health } = require(process.cwd() + '/app.js'); const result = health(); if (!result || result.status !== 'ok') { console.error('health() returned ' + JSON.stringify(result)); process.exit(1); }
